context.region: Specify region; do not infer it from a palette
context.locality: Specify the depicted locality or fictional place
context.narrativeFrame: Specify the depicted period, or explicitly retain an unknown date
context.sourceFrame: Specify source title, edition, date and relevant passage
context.uncertainty: Unverified template: replace placeholders and distinguish source evidence from artistic interpretation.

direction.signature: Describe the one spatial feature that distinguishes this world
direction.composition: Place people beside meaningful tasks, work surfaces and paths
direction.wardrobe: Specify garment construction, role, layers, fabric and source limitations
direction.materialDetail: Specify local construction, surface response and wear from use

activities: Specify one purposeful human activity and its still/rest phase
life.creatureRestraint: No creatures selected; add only after a habitat and source review

space.interiorTarget: Specify one structure and room function, or choose no interior
space.review: Check doorway, floor, steps, furniture footprints, fallback and return route

atmosphere.lighting: Specify key light, readable face/prop values and interior bounce
atmosphere.motion: Specify flexible surfaces, purposeful gestures, phases and reduced motion
atmosphere.sound: Specify quiet opt-in ambience and where silence is intentional

avoid: List an inappropriate period, prop, creature or repeated composition to exclude
nextPasses: Name one bounded improvement with a concrete validation result
